components.purpose: One-line notice at the very top of the page announcing the new release (uses the single required 'Message' text field, optionally linking out).
Full-width opening banner — this model is purpose-built to render at the top of a page under the menu, and has two link fields (CTA 1, CTA 2) for the two buttons.
Customer logos section — nested grid of logo items displayed as a strip.
Final 'Get started' call to action — heading plus a Primary Button (and optional Secondary Button) banner, suited to closing out the page.
